fact: Since its nationwide rollout in 2019 the ministry's online EMIS covers primary grades 4-8 only, secondary and ABE; primary grades 1-3 and individual student-level data are not yet captured, and a revision is being commissioned.
title: Terms of Reference (TOR) For Revision and Expansion of the Education Management Information System (EMIS)
publisher: Ministry of Education, Culture and Higher Education, Directorate of Basic Education, EMIS Department
